# Model card: Guardrail injection classifier (suspicious spans)

| | |
|---|---|
| Purpose | A second look at spans the deterministic detectors flagged: is this text an injection? |
| Workflow | core |
| Code | `pairly_core.guardrails.classifier.apply_classifier`, `RouterInjectionClassifier` |
| Prompt | `guardrails_injection_classify` version `v1`, file SHA-256 `5db08148d3b3b239...` |
| Output schema | `InjectionVerdicts` |
| Model tiers, cheapest first | `small` (anthropic `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001`, openai `gpt-6-luna`) |
| Temperature | 0.0 |
| Output token limit | 1024 |
| Confidence threshold to accept | none |

## Inputs

Only the suspicious spans, each JSON-quoted inside a data-only frame.

## Outputs

`InjectionVerdicts`: a verdict and a confidence per span.

## Human oversight

It can raise a low finding to medium (removed from model input, so a person reviews), never lower or clear one. Any failure keeps every deterministic finding.

## Limits

* Available to workflows; no workflow turns it on today.
* Sees only what the detectors already found, so it cannot find new spans.
* Every call is logged in `model_calls` (prompt version and hash, model, inputs, output, tokens, cost) and fails closed: no model means a person does the step.

## Evals

No eval measures this component yet.
